title: Activity Diagram — Reschedule Appointment
preconditions: 3. Patient and facility communicated and agreed to the change.
4. Candidate destination must belong to the same ServiceOffering and preserve saved terms.

nodes.label: Staff selects CONFIRMED Appointment and chooses Reschedule Appointment
Display current booking snapshot / history and permitted destination context
Staff selects agreed new day / group / session
Validate Appointment state, same ServiceOffering, same saved terms and destination bookability
Appointment still CONFIRMED and destination uses same ServiceOffering / terms?
Reject in-place reschedule; use saved cancellation + normal new-booking path for different terms
Staff confirms proposed move and records reason
Atomically secure valid destination capacity first
Abort move and preserve original Appointment / old capacity
Update scheduling/group details while Appointment remains CONFIRMED
Release old capacity only after destination is secured
Record previous/new scheduling data, actor, reason and history
Show successfully rescheduled CONFIRMED Appointment and unchanged financial snapshot

explicitly_forbidden: Release old seat before new seat is secured.
qa_gates: 1. Verify the exact Use Case title and scope.
2. Verify the Initial Node exists and has no incoming flow.
3. Verify the Activity Final exists and has no outgoing flow.
4. Verify every Action is source-supported and verb-led.
5. Verify every Decision has meaningful guarded outgoing flows.
6. Verify every Merge is used only to reunite alternatives, not as decoration.
7. Verify Fork/Join is absent unless true parallelism is explicitly required.
8. Verify all arrows are Control Flows unless an Object Flow is explicitly specified.
10. Verify no Sequence lifeline/message notation appears.
11. Verify actor permissions and product boundaries.
12. Verify independent lifecycle states are not collapsed into one generic status.
13. Verify all rendered branch guards are mutually understandable and not contradictory.
14. Render SVG/PNG/PDF; open every actual output and inspect it visually.
15. Compare the render against this MD item-by-item and correct semantic, notation, routing, and readability issues.
